## Example 3.9 {#iv3-example-3-9 .vector-lesson .component-lesson .position-lesson}

What vector represents going from the point $(3,1)$ to the point $(-1,-5)$?

<div data-position="example9"></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.9 · p. 24</div>

::: notes
The vector is (-4,-6), or -4i-6j. First show the two points. Reveal the directed segment and calculation after students work. The supporting diagram is new; the question and values are unchanged. Movement is four left and six down.
:::
